summary: Residential street with houses 5-10 m from the north kerb all along.
reasons: Homes on both sides of street

best_section.where: Rennie Street north kerb, west of the large new apartment block

drivers.seclusion: Mapped houses at 5-10 m for the first 90 m; later stretch has homes 23-30 m away but the street is lined with houses opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along both kerbs; room to park looks fine.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along the kerb; no signs mapped.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m of most sections
sun_shade: Heavy tree cover over the kerb in the middle, shading from the north side.
